_about: T981 inventory: B.C. waters closed to fishing by a municipal / park bylaw (not the synopsis). MACHINE OUTPUT, PROPOSALS ONLY (memory everything-added-is-a-proposal): nothing here is accepted, and nothing reads this file. Each row is a proposal the owner accepts or rejects one by one. status: proposed = primary source quoted, water matched; needs_owner_call = the bylaw text closes park waters broadly but the synopsis prints open rules for the same water, so the owner decides; needs_source = asked for, but no primary source names a closure; not_a_closure = checked, no fishing closure in the text. Quotes copied from the fetched documents on 2026-11-21 (Claude, lane/085-t981). item_id from data/generated/atlas/full/registry.json (live atlas).

rows.water: Swan Lake (Swan Lake Christmas Hill Nature Sanctuary, Saanich)
rows.item_match: exact (Swan Lake, MU 1-1; the other Swan Lakes are in Regions 3, 5, 6, 7, 8)
rows.authority: Swan Lake Christmas Hill Nature Sanctuary Society, under District of Saanich Parks Management and Control Bylaw No. 7753
rows.bylaw: Saanich Parks Management and Control Bylaw, 1997, No. 7753: 'PARK' includes the Sanctuary, and s.2.1(a) lets the Society's Executive Director exercise the Parks Manager's authority there. No fishing section in 7753 itself; the closure is the Sanctuary's posted rule.
rows.section: Sanctuary rules (Visitors' Guide); bylaw 7753 s.2.1(a) for the authority
rows.quote: NO HUNTING / FISHING / BOATING: Or any other water recreation in the lake
rows.conflicts: none: no synopsis entry for this Swan Lake
rows.confidence: medium (the authority's own page; no bylaw section names fishing)

rows.water: every lake or stream in a Burnaby park (candidates: Deer Lake wbk:328976459, Burnaby Lake wbk:329291868, Central Park pond (not in registry))
rows.bylaw: Burnaby Parks Regulation Bylaw 1979, No. 7331 (consolidated with amendments to No. 14812, May 12, 2026)
rows.quote: 4. No person shall molest, disturb, frighten, injure, trap or snare any bird or animal, or fish in any lake or stream in any park without the special permission of the Administrator.
rows.conflicts: the synopsis prints open rules for both lakes: r2:deer_lake_burnaby@2-8 'Trout/char daily quota = 2; single barbless hook; no powered boats', r2:burnaby_lake@2-8 'Single barbless hook; No powered boats' (and r2:burnaby_lake_s_tributaries@2-8 is already No Fishing). The province consulted on Deer Lake and Burnaby Lake angling rules in 2025, so fishing is practised there; Burnaby Lake is a Metro Vancouver regional park.
rows.confidence: low for any one water (the text bans it, practice and the synopsis say open; whether the Administrator's permission is given generally is unknown)

rows.water: every lake or stream in a Surrey park, except designated and posted areas (candidate: Green Timbers Lake wbk:360887617, stocked, almost certainly a designated area)
rows.bylaw: Surrey Parks, Recreation and Cultural Facilities Regulation By-law, 1998, No. 13480 (as amended to 20933, 05/15/23)
rows.quote: 34. No person shall within a park: (a) fish or angle in any lake or stream without the prior written permission of the General Manager except in an area designated and posted for such purposes by the General Manager;
rows.extent: authority-wide (park waters), minus designated areas we do not have a list of
rows.confidence: high for the rule, low for any one water (the designated areas are not published in the bylaw)
